pens.name: 2x Blend
pens._source: Peptide Therapy Collective 2x Blend card: 12 mg vial reconstituted with 4 mL BAC water = 0.03 mg per unit. Recommended dose 1–3 mg (30–100 units). The dose is the BLEND TOTAL, not tesamorelin alone.
pens.notes: Administer once daily, preferably in a fasted state or prior to bedtime. Rotate injection sites as needed.
